title: द्विपञ्चाशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: The Kauravas rejoice to see Alayudha, and Karna, freed from the rakshasa, goes against Bhima. Krishna, seeing Bhima beset by Alayudha, sends Ghatotkacha to meet the demon.
summary.kn: ಅಲಾಯುಧನನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಕೌರವರು ಹರ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ; ರಾಕ್ಷಸನಿಂದ ಮುಕ್ತನಾದ ಕರ್ಣ ಭೀಮನ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅಲಾಯುಧನಿಂದ ಭೀಮ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಹಾಕಿಕೊಂಡುದನ್ನು ಕಂಡ ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಘಟೋತ್ಕಚನನ್ನು ಅವನ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: अलायुध को देखकर कौरव हर्षित होते हैं और राक्षस से मुक्त हुआ कर्ण भीम पर चढ़ता है। अलायुध से घिरे भीम को देखकर कृष्ण घटोत्कच को उस राक्षस के विरुद्ध भेजते हैं।
summary.te: అలాయుధుని చూసి కౌరవులు సంతోషిస్తారు; రాక్షసుని నుండి విడివడిన కర్ణుడు భీమునిపై వెళ్తాడు. అలాయుధునిచే భీముడు చుట్టుముట్టబడటం చూసి కృష్ణుడు ఘటోత్కచుని అతనిపైకి పంపుతాడు.
summary.ta: அலாயுதனைக் கண்டு கௌரவர் மகிழ, அரக்கனிடமிருந்து விடுபட்ட கர்ணன் பீமனை நோக்கிச் செல்கிறான். அலாயுதனால் பீமன் சூழப்படுவதைக் கண்ட கண்ணன் கடோத்கசனை அவன் மீது ஏவுகிறார்.
summary.ml: അലായുധനെ കണ്ട് കൗരവർ സന്തോഷിക്കുന്നു; രാക്ഷസനിൽനിന്ന് മോചിതനായ കർണ്ണൻ ഭീമന്റെ നേർക്ക് പോകുന്നു. അലായുധൻ ഭീമനെ വളയുന്നത് കണ്ട കൃഷ്ണൻ ആ രാക്ഷസനെ നേരിടാൻ ഘടോൽക്കചനെ അയയ്ക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.152; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य भीमकर्माणमाहवे ।
हर्षमाहारयां चक्रुः कुरवः सर्व एव ते ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him arrive, the one whose deeds in battle matched Bhima's own, all the Kurus were filled with joy.

verses.text:
तथैव तव पुत्रास्ते दुर्योधनपुरोगमाः ।
अप्लवाः प्लवमासाद्य तर्तुकामा इवार्णवम् ॥

meaning.en: So too were your sons with Duryodhana at their head, like men with no boat who have found one and wish to cross the ocean.

verses.text:
पुनर्जातमिवात्मानं मन्वानाः पार्थिवास्तदा ।
अलायुधं राक्षसेन्द्रं स्वागतेनाभ्यपूजयन् ॥

meaning.en: Thinking themselves born again, the kings welcomed the rakshasa lord Alayudha with a greeting of honor.

verses.text:
तस्मिंस्त्वमानुषे युद्धे वर्तमाने भयावहे ।
कर्णराक्षसयोर्नक्तं दारुणप्रतिदर्शने ॥

meaning.en: As that superhuman, fearful and dreadful night battle between Karna and the rakshasa went on,

verses.text:
उपप्रैक्षन्त पाञ्चालाः स्मयमानाः सराजकाः ।
तथैव तावका राजन्घूर्णमानास्ततस्ततः ॥

meaning.en: the Panchalas and their kings watched it, smiling, and your men too, O king, reeled this way and that.

verses.text:
चुक्रुशुर्नेदमस्तीति द्रोणद्रौणिकृपादयः ।
तत्कर्म दृष्ट्वा संभ्रान्ता हैडिम्बस्य रणाजिरे ॥

meaning.en: Drona, Drona's son, Kripa and others cried out, 'This cannot go on!' bewildered by what the son of Hidimba was doing on the field.

verses.text:
सर्वमाविग्नमभवद्धाहाभूतमचेतनम् ।
तव सैन्यं महाराज निराशं कर्णजीविते ॥

meaning.en: Your whole army was shaken, wailing and dazed, O great king, with no hope left for Karna's life.

verses.text:
दुर्योधनस्तु संप्रेक्ष्य कर्णमार्तिं परां गतम् ।
अलायुधं राक्षसेन्द्रमाहूयेदमथाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Karna in the deepest distress, Duryodhana summoned the rakshasa lord Alayudha and said this.

verses.text:
एष वैकर्तनः कर्णो हैडिम्बेन समागतः ।
कुरुते कर्म सुमहद्यदस्यौपयिकं मृधे ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana said: Here is Karna, son of Vikartana, who has met the son of Hidimba. He is doing all that a man can in battle.

verses.text:
पश्यैतान्पार्थिवाञ्शूरान्निहतान्भैमसेनिना ।
नानाशस्त्रैरभिहतान्पादपानिव दन्तिना ॥

meaning.en: Look at these brave kings, struck down by Bhima's son, hit by weapons of every sort, like trees broken by an elephant.

verses.text:
तवैष भागः समरे राजमध्ये मया कृतः ।
तवैवानुमते वीर तं विक्रम्य निबर्हय ॥

meaning.en: In this battle I have set this one aside for you, in the midst of the kings. With your own consent, hero, go at him with valor and destroy him.

verses.text:
पुरा वैकर्तनं कर्णमेष पापो घटोत्कचः ।
मायाबलमुपाश्रित्य कर्शयत्यरिकर्शनः ॥

meaning.en: This wicked Ghatotkacha, a tormentor of foes, is wearing down Karna, son of Vikartana, by relying on the strength of his illusions.

verses.text:
एवमुक्तः स राज्ञा तु राक्षसस्तीव्रविक्रमः ।
तथेत्युक्त्वा महाबाहुर्घटोत्कचमुपाद्रवत् ॥

meaning.en: Addressed so by the king, the rakshasa of fierce prowess and mighty arms said 'Very well' and rushed at Ghatotkacha.

verses.text:
ततः कर्णं समुत्सृज्य भैमसेनिरपि प्रभो ।
प्रत्यमित्रमुपायान्तं मर्दयामास मार्गणैः ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhima's son, leaving Karna, O lord, ground down with his arrows the enemy coming at him.

verses.text:
तयोः समभवद्युद्धं क्रुद्धयो राक्षसेन्द्रयोः ।
मत्तयोर्वाशिताहेतोर्द्विपयोरिव कानने ॥

meaning.en: A fight began between those two enraged rakshasa lords, like two rutting elephants fighting in a forest over a cow elephant.

verses.text:
रक्षसा विप्रमुक्तस्तु कर्णोऽपि रथिनां वरः ।
अभ्यद्रवद्भीमसेनं रथेनादित्यवर्चसा ॥

meaning.en: Karna too, the best of charioteers, freed from the rakshasa, rushed at Bhima in his chariot bright as the sun.

verses.text:
तमायान्तमनादृत्य दृष्ट्वा ग्रस्तं घटोत्कचम् ।
अलायुधेन समरे सिंहेनेव गवां पतिम् ॥

meaning.en: Paying no heed to Karna's approach, Bhima saw Ghatotkacha seized by Alayudha in the fight, as a lion seizes a lord of cattle.

verses.text:
रथेनादित्यवपुषा भीमः प्रहरतां वरः ।
किरञ्शरौघान्प्रययावलायुधरथं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Bhima, best of fighters, in a chariot with the radiance of the sun, went toward Alayudha's chariot, pouring down floods of arrows.

verses.text:
तमायान्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य स तदालायुधः प्रभो ।
घटोत्कचं समुत्सृज्य भीमसेनं समाह्वयत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him come, Alayudha, O lord, left Ghatotkacha and challenged Bhima.

verses.text:
तं भीमः सहसाभ्येत्य राक्षसान्तकरः प्रभो ।
सगणं राक्षसेन्द्रं तं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत् ॥

meaning.en: Bhima, slayer of rakshasas, charged at him at once and showered that rakshasa lord and his troop with rains of arrows.

verses.text:
तथैवालायुधो राजञ्शिलाधौतैरजिह्मगैः ।
अभ्यवर्षत कौन्तेयं पुनः पुनररिंदमः ॥

meaning.en: Alayudha in turn, O king, scourge of enemies, showered the son of Kunti again and again with straight-flying arrows sharpened on stone.

verses.text:
तथा ते राक्षसाः सर्वे भीमसेनमुपाद्रवन् ।
नानाप्रहरणा भीमास्त्वत्सुतानां जयैषिणः ॥

meaning.en: Then all those rakshasas, terrible, with weapons of every sort and wishing victory for your sons, rushed at Bhima.

verses.text:
स ताड्यमानो बलिभिर्भीमसेनो महाबलः ।
पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिः सर्वांस्तानविध्यच्छितैः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: Struck by those powerful beings, mighty Bhima pierced every one of them with sharp arrows, five apiece.

verses.text:
ते वध्यमाना भीमेन राक्षसाः खरयोनयः ।
विनेदुस्तुमुलान्नादान्दुद्रुवुश्च दिशो दश ॥

meaning.en: Those rakshasas, born of donkey-like stock, as Bhima killed them, let out tumultuous cries and fled in all ten directions.

verses.text:
तांस्त्रास्यमानान्भीमेन दृष्ट्वा रक्षो महाबलम् ।
अभिदुद्राव वेगेन शरैश्चैनमवाकिरत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing them driven in terror by Bhima, the mighty rakshasa Alayudha rushed forward with speed and covered Bhima with arrows.

verses.text:
तं भीमसेनः समरे तीक्ष्णाग्रैरक्षिणोच्छरैः ।
अलायुधस्तु तानस्तान्भीमेन विशिखान्रणे ।
चिच्छेद कांश्चित्समरे त्वरया कांश्चिदग्रहीत् ॥

meaning.en: Bhima wounded him in battle with sharp-pointed arrows. Alayudha cut some of Bhima's shafts in two with speed and caught others.

verses.text:
स तं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसेन्द्रं भीमो भीमपराक्रमः ।
गदां चिक्षेप वेगेन वज्रपातोपमां तदा ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that rakshasa lord, Bhima, of fearsome prowess, hurled his mace swiftly, like a thunderbolt falling.

verses.text:
तामापतन्तीं वेगेन गदां ज्वालाकुलां ततः ।
गदया ताडयामास सा गदा भीममाव्रजत् ॥

meaning.en: As that mace, ringed with flame, came rushing, Alayudha struck it with his own mace, and it flew back toward Bhima.

verses.text:
स राक्षसेन्द्रं कौन्तेयः शरवर्षैरवाकिरत् ।
तानप्यस्याकरोन्मोघान्राक्षसो निशितैः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: The son of Kunti showered the rakshasa lord with arrows, but the rakshasa made them useless with his sharp shafts.

verses.text:
ते चापि राक्षसाः सर्वे सैनिका भीमरूपिणः ।
शासनाद्राक्षसेन्द्रस्य निजघ्नू रथकुञ्जरान् ॥

meaning.en: All those soldiers, rakshasas of fearful look, at their lord's command slew chariots and elephants.

verses.text:
पाञ्चालाः सृञ्जयाश्चैव वाजिनः परमद्विपाः ।
न शान्तिं लेभिरे तत्र रक्षसैर्भृशपीडिताः ॥

meaning.en: The Panchalas and Srinjayas, with horses and the finest elephants, found no peace there, sorely harried by the rakshasas.

verses.text:
तं तु दृष्ट्वा महाघोरं वर्तमानं महाहवे ।
अब्रवीत्पुरुषश्रेष्ठो धनंजयमिदं वचः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that dreadful being at work in the great battle, the best of men, Krishna, spoke these words to Dhananjaya.

verses.text:
पश्य भीमं महाबाहो राक्षसेन्द्रवशं गतम् ।
पदवीमस्य गच्छ त्वं मा विचारय पाण्डव ॥

meaning.en: Krishna said: See, mighty-armed one, Bhima has fallen under the sway of the rakshasa lord. Follow his path, son of Pandu; do not hesitate.

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नः शिखण्डी च युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ ।
सहिता द्रौपदेयाश्च कर्णं यान्तु महारथाः ॥

meaning.en: Let Dhrishtadyumna and Shikhandi, Yudhamanyu and Uttamauja, and the sons of Draupadi, all great chariot-warriors, go together against Karna.

verses.text:
नकुलः सहदेवश्च युयुधानश्च वीर्यवान् ।
इतरान्राक्षसान्घ्नन्तु शासनात्तव पाण्डव ॥

meaning.en: Let Nakula, Sahadeva and the valiant Yuyudhana kill the other rakshasas at your command, son of Pandu.

verses.text:
त्वमपीमां महाबाहो चमूं द्रोणपुरस्कृताम् ।
वारयस्व नरव्याघ्र महद्धि भयमागतम् ॥

meaning.en: And you, mighty-armed tiger among men, check this army led by Drona, for great danger has come.

verses.text:
एवमुक्ते तु कृष्णेन यथोद्दिष्टा महारथाः ।
जग्मुर्वैकर्तनं कर्णं राक्षसांश्चेतरान्रणे ॥

meaning.en: When Krishna had spoken so, the great chariot-warriors went, as assigned, against Karna, son of Vikartana, and the other rakshasas in the battle.

verses.text:
अथ पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैः शरैराशीविषोपमैः ।
धनुश्चिच्छेद भीमस्य राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान् ॥

meaning.en: Then the mighty rakshasa lord, with arrows loosed from a fully drawn bow, like venomous snakes, cut Bhima's bow in two.

verses.text:
हयांश्चास्य शितैर्बाणैः सारथिं च महाबलः ।
जघान मिषतः संख्ये भीमसेनस्य भारत ॥

meaning.en: That powerful being killed Bhima's horses and his charioteer with sharp arrows, as Bhima looked on in the fight, O Bharata.

verses.text:
सोऽवतीर्य रथोपस्थाद्धताश्वो हतसारथिः ।
तस्मै गुर्वीं गदां घोरां स विनद्योत्ससर्ज ह ॥

meaning.en: With horses and charioteer slain, Bhima leapt down from the chariot's seat and, roaring, hurled at him a heavy and dreadful mace.

verses.text:
ततस्तां भीमनिर्घोषामापतन्तीं महागदाम् ।
गदया राक्षसो घोरो निजघान ननाद च ॥

meaning.en: That great mace came on with a terrible roar, and the dread rakshasa struck it down with his own mace and bellowed.

verses.text:
तद्दृष्ट्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य घोरं कर्म भयावहम् ।
भीमसेनः प्रहृष्टात्मा गदामाशु परामृशत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that fearful, terrible deed of the rakshasa lord, Bhima, in high spirits, quickly seized another mace.

verses.text:
तयोः समभवद्युद्धं तुमुलं नररक्षसोः ।
गदानिपातसंह्रादैर्भुवं कम्पयतोर्भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: A tumultuous fight began between the man and the rakshasa, the crash of their maces shaking the earth hard.

verses.text:
गदाविमुक्तौ तौ भूयः समासाद्येतरेतरम् ।
मुष्टिभिर्वज्रसंह्रादैरन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः ॥

meaning.en: Their maces gone, they closed again and struck each other with fists that sounded like thunderbolts.

verses.text:
रथचक्रैर्युगैरक्षैरधिष्ठानैरुपस्करैः ।
यथासन्नमुपादाय निजघ्नतुरमर्षणौ ॥

meaning.en: In their anger they snatched whatever was near, wheels of chariots, yokes, axles, platforms and fittings, and beat each other with them.

verses.text:
तौ विक्षरन्तौ रुधिरं समासाद्येतरेतरम् ।
मत्ताविव महानागावकृष्येतां पुनः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: Streaming blood, they came together and dragged each other again and again like two great rutting elephants.

verses.text:
तमपश्यद्धृषीकेशः पाण्डवानां हिते रतः ।
स भीमसेनरक्षार्थं हैडिम्बं प्रत्यचोदयत् ॥

meaning.en: Hrishikesha, devoted to the Pandavas' good, saw them and urged the son of Hidimba to protect Bhima.
